 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Manoj Jain

% 03.02.2026 CRL.M.A. 3539/2026 (exemption) Exemption allowed subject to all just exceptions.

1. Petitioner seeks quashing of FIR No.596/2023 dated 19.12.2023, registered at P.S. G.T.B. Enclave,
for commission of offences under Sections 323/376/506 of IPC, 1860.
2. Prosecutrix (respondent No.2 herein) is present in Court, and admits that the matter has been amicably settled and she would have no objection if the instant FIR is quashed.
When asked, she submitted that she would not be requiring any legal assistance in relation to present petition.
3. Her examination-in-chief has already been recorded by the learned Trial Court and since she deviated from the case of prosecution, the case is This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 04/02/2026 at 20:38:55 now fixed for 07th instant for her cross-examination by the prosecution.

4. Let brief reply be filed by respondent No.1/State with advance copy to opposite side.
5. List on 20.02.2026.
MANOJ JAIN, J FEBRUARY 3, 2026 st/sa
